name: NRE 4150
title: Ecosystem Science and Management
description: Ecosystem biogeochemical processes, the organism-environment interactions that regulate them, and natural resources management strategies that explicitly consider ecosystem structure and function.
requirement_description: EEB 2244E or equivalent general ecology course; CHEM 1127Q or equivalent general chemistry course; instructor consent required. This course and NRE 5150 may not both be taken for credit.
